newsitem.title: UK: UK's Mawhinney attacks Labour over tax.
newsitem.headline: UK's Mawhinney attacks Labour over tax.

text.p: Conservative Party chairman Brian Mawhinney on Friday accused the opposition Labour Party of being "shameless opportunists" on income tax and failing to close off options to increase it.
Speaking to the annual conference of the Welsh Conservatives, Mawhinney said Labour economic spokesman Gordon Brown had merely ruled out increasing the rates of income tax.
"Note how carefully New Labour choose their words. No increase in income tax rates," Mawhinney said.
"Not a word about allowances, not a word about corporation tax....not a word about genuine reliefs for family and other businesses. The danger is in what New Labour don't tell you."
